basis: Severe immune-mediated cutaneous drug reactions; persistent extracutaneous damage is not common across all included subtypes.
Immune-mediated airway papillomatosis; atrophic skin lesions in 2/2. [MedGen](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/medgen/1719353/).
Inherited interstitial lung disease with defining cerebral abnormalities; insufficient frequency evidence for additional organs across both subtypes.
Autoinflammatory umbrella; no specific organ damage is established as common across the group.
Carcinoma originates in major salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Obstetric implantation disorder; reproductive organs have no axis. Hemorrhage is a complication, not a primary blood disorder.
Defining joint fusions and dental/oral malformations; functional eye or ear damage unproven. [Case report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12838559/).
Myeloid blasts proliferate in marrow and blood; extramedullary tissue involvement is uncommon.
Inherited apolipoprotein and HDL metabolism disorder; coronary atherosclerosis is a separately diagnosed downstream disease.
Congenital pancreatic insulin hypersecretion; lasting hypoglycemic brain injury is not established in at least 30% across this responsive subgroup.
Liver flukes occupy and injure the biliary tract; cholangiocarcinoma is a separate later complication.
Genetically defined combined immunodeficiency; no common direct damage to additional organs is supplied.
Erythropoietic disease; hepatomegaly alone lacks damage evidence; common intrinsic cardiac/thyroid injury unproven. [Series](https://doi.org/10.1002/pbc.30245).
The syndrome is defined by acute myeloid leukemia together with adenomatous colonic polyposis and colon cancer.
Storage causes splenic/marrow disease with anemia 80-99%, hepatic infiltration 80-99%, skeletal damage 30-79%; cap prioritizes these over neurologic findings enriched in neuronopathic subtypes.
Congenital pancreatic ring causes duodenal stenosis or obstruction; no defining endocrine dysfunction.
Contractures, developmental brain abnormalities and Robin sequence define disease; cleft palate/glossoptosis affect the mouth. Sleep apnea is a separately diagnosed secondary condition.
Excess aromatase causes estrogen excess; accelerated skeletal maturation alone does not establish bone damage, and short stature is occasional.
Infantile myoclonus, ataxia and opsoclonus indicate central motor dysfunction; abnormal eye movements do not establish structural ocular damage.
Hereditary optic nerve degeneration causes reduced visual acuity and visual field constriction; optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Nonsyndromic intellectual disability defines the disorder; no additional organ dysfunction or metabolic phenotype is established.
Disrupted atrial electrical conduction is an intrinsic cardiac disorder.
Epileptic encephalopathy with developmental regression and cerebral atrophy; optic atrophy is occasional, and hypotonia does not establish muscle disease.
Defining orthostatic tachycardia arises from impaired autonomic neurotransmitter clearance; transient blurred vision and dyspnea do not establish eye or lung damage.
Intellectual disability and syndromic obesity define disease; sensorineural hearing loss in 4/7. Eyelid/facial dysmorphism lacks evidence of visual dysfunction.
